Tesla Cybercab just revealed some impressive numbers. 

According to new EPA filings, the Cybercab is expected to deliver up to 418 miles (673 km) of rangewhile using a surprisingly small battery pack.

If these figures hold up in the real world, Cybercab could become one of the most energy-efficient EVs ever produced — a major step toward scalable, low-cost autonomous transportation.

The future of mobility is getting closer.
